=== backward branch to a label
start:
        add     a0, a0, a1
        addi    a1, a1, -1
        bnez    a1, start
        ret

=== forward branch to a label
        beqz    a0, done
        li      a0, 1
done:
        ret

=== a branch too far for the compressed form
        beqz    a0, far
        .space  300
far:
        ret

=== a branch too far for any branch, needing the layout pass to notice early
        bnez    a0, near
near:
        nop

=== jump range
        j       ahead
        .space  4000
ahead:
        j       back
back:
        nop

=== a jump past the reach of c.j
        j       ahead
        .space  4000
        nop
ahead:
        ret

=== call and tail to a local label
target:
        ret
        call    target
        tail    target

=== call to an undefined symbol
        call    external
        tail    external

=== la of a local label
        la      a0, value
        lla     a1, value
value:
        ret

=== an explicit pcrel_hi / pcrel_lo pair
1:      auipc   a0, %pcrel_hi(sym)
        addi    a0, a0, %pcrel_lo(1b)
        lw      a1, %pcrel_lo(1b)(a0)

=== hi and lo of an absolute symbol
        lui     a0, %hi(sym)
        addi    a0, a0, %lo(sym)
        sw      a1, %lo(sym)(a0)

=== norvc turns compression off
        .option norvc
        add     a0, a0, a1
        mv      a1, a2
        ret
        .option rvc
        add     a0, a0, a1

=== option push and pop restore the previous setting
        add     a0, a0, a1
        .option push
        .option norvc
        add     a0, a0, a1
        .option pop
        add     a0, a0, a1

=== a prologue and epilogue in the usual style
func:
        addi    sp, sp, -32
        sd      ra, 24(sp)
        sd      s0, 16(sp)
        addi    s0, sp, 32
        li      a0, 0
        call    helper
        ld      ra, 24(sp)
        ld      s0, 16(sp)
        addi    sp, sp, 32
        ret

=== a loop with local labels
        li      t0, 10
1:      addi    t0, t0, -1
        bnez    t0, 1b
        j       2f
        nop
2:      ret

=== alignment padding is real no-ops
        add     a0, a0, a1
        .p2align 3
        add     a0, a0, a1
        .p2align 2
        ret
